$description: cobaltcounsel.com base palette as of 2026-09-29, exported from src/css/main.css (consolidation branch). Design Tokens (W3C DTCG) format. 'uses' counts var() references in main.css. One amber accent on a warm, plum-tinted neutral ramp.

amber.$description: --color-primary. The only accent: buttons, link underlines, highlighter swash, list bullets, stat numbers, logo bars. Also hard-coded as the manifest theme_color, the Calendly primary_color and the logo SVG fill. 23 uses + logo + Calendly + manifest.

peach.$description: --color-tertiary. Declared but unused (0 uses). Carried over from the Gatsby theme.

ink.$description: --color-black. Dark bands (booking section, proof strip), text on amber buttons. Also the Calendly background_color. 10 uses.

heading.$description: --color-heading. Plum-tinted near-black for headings and emphasis. 20 uses.

text.$description: Body text: hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.8) on <body>, a neutral grey that doesn't match the plum-tinted ramp. Posts use #3A343D instead (below). Not a token today.

text-post.$description: Post body text (.post-body). Hard-coded; closer to the ramp than the <body> colour.

gray.$description: --color-gray. Secondary text, nav links, paragraph copy in sections. 21 uses.

light-gray.$description: --color-light-gray. Meta text: dates, captions, eyebrows. 10 uses.

hairline.$description: Warm borders and dividers (post cards, post footer, tables). Hard-coded, 3 uses; #ECE6E0 (service card border) is a near-duplicate.

surface.$description: --color-secondary. Warm off-white: hero, tinted bands, tags, 'Top' button. 11 uses.

white.$description: --color-white. Cards and text on dark bands. 9 uses; also the Calendly text_color.

strays.$description: Hard-coded colours outside the palette. A new palette should absorb these rather than carry them forward.

logo-dark.$description: Logo SVG dark fill (Logo.svg, logoWithName.svg). Doesn't match ink or heading.

dropdown-bg.$description: Nav dropdown menu background (cool grey, not the warm surface).

button-glow.$description: Button hover shadow, rgb(242 187 99 / 0.4): an amber tint.
